moves.label: Quick Hades Shot
moves.description: Fast high pistol check with a tiny active window and guarded recovery.
moves.reason: Train visibly aims Hades forward for a quick high check.

moves.label: Low Gunner Sweep
moves.description: Steady low sweep with huge active movement and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low sweeping motion attacks along the leg line.

moves.label: Hades Body Shot
moves.description: Quick mid pistol shot with a brief active hit and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Forward pistol shot targets the torso line.

moves.label: Sweeper Slide Kick
moves.description: Slow mid slide kick with huge active travel and quick finish.
moves.reason: Train slides forward through a body-height kick sequence.

moves.label: Sweeper Slide Shot
moves.description: Slow mid sliding shot with a long active path and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Sliding gun stance moves forward without launcher or knockdown flags.

moves.label: Hades Launcher Shot
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active pistol pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Gun sequence is authored as a launcher and rises into the final shot.

moves.label: Black Cat Tornado Kick
moves.description: Quick mid jumping tornado kick with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Acrobatic spinning kick supports tornado and jump properties.

moves.label: Homing Low Feint
moves.description: Slow low homing feint that ends crouched after a long active step.
moves.reason: Low route is authored with homing tracking and crouch-end.

moves.label: Low Sweeper Knockdown
moves.description: Slow low knockdown kick with long active reach and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low forward kick is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Black Cat Tornado Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid jumping tornado launcher with a modest active spin.
moves.reason: Airborne spin is authored as both launcher and tornado.

moves.label: Crouch Hades Rush
moves.description: Quick mid crouch rush with long active pistol pressure and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route advances into repeated pistol poses.

moves.label: Crouch Hades Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active shot and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-shot motion is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Hades Shot
moves.description: Fast high overdrive shot with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive route reuses Train's high pistol check.

moves.label: Hades Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown drive with huge active pistol pressure.
moves.reason: Long pistol-pressure special is authored as a knockdown drive.

moves.label: Rising Hades Shot
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising shot with a long active burst and quick finish.
moves.reason: While-standing command fires through the torso line.

moves.label: Rising Sweeper Rush
moves.description: Instant mid while-rising rush with long active movement and high recovery.
moves.reason: Rising route advances through repeated pistol/kick poses.

moves.label: Ducking Hades Shot
moves.description: Fast high ducking shot with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab repeats the high pistol-check frames.

moves.label: Diagonal Hades Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with a tiny active shot and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward shot is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Forward Hades Shot
moves.description: Slow mid forward shot with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward input uses a body-height pistol shot.

moves.label: Forward Hades Burst
moves.description: Steady mid forward burst with a long active shot and quick finish.
moves.reason: Forward-heavy command extends the pistol-pressure sequence.

moves.label: Hades Quick Shot
moves.description: Fast high quarter-circle shot with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab repeats the high Hades shot animation.

moves.label: Black Cat Knockdown
moves.description: Steady mid jumping knockdown with huge active acrobatic travel.
moves.reason: Acrobatic kick route leaves the ground and is authored as knockdown.
